verdict.rationale: Honeycomb lets users configure Triggers and SLO burn alerts that evaluate continuously in the background and fire to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks with templated JSON payloads. Its API supports programmatic management of triggers and SLOs for automated workflows. This is threshold-driven alerting automation rather than autonomous agentic work, though: its MCP and agent-skill features are driven by an external AI agent, not scheduled background jobs. Missing for 10: native autonomous or scheduled agent workflows that act without a human or external agent, automated remediation beyond notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
